virtual_template|loyaltyandachievements|.definition: rankpos = RANK() OVER (ORDER BY inflscore DESC, trustval DESC)

virtual_template|loyaltyandachievements|.description: reputelv is the reputation level category assigned from trust value thresholds. Selects 24% of rows.
virtual_template|loyaltyandachievements|.definition: reputelv = CASE WHEN trustval >= 90 THEN 'Elite' WHEN trustval >= 70 THEN 'Respected' WHEN trustval >= 40 THEN 'Established' ELSE 'New' END

virtual_template|loyaltyandachievements|.description: rewtier is the reward tier category assigned from loyalty points thresholds. Selects 26% of rows.
virtual_template|loyaltyandachievements|.definition: json_extract(reward_progress, '$.loyalty.rewtier') = CASE WHEN json_extract(reward_progress, '$.loyalty.loypts') >= 40000 THEN 'Platinum' WHEN json_extract(reward_progress, '$.loyalty.loypts') >= 30000 THEN 'Gold' WHEN json_extract(reward_progress, '$.loyalty.loypts') >= 20000 THEN 'Silver' ELSE 'Bronze' END

virtual_template|loyaltyandachievements|.description: loypts is the loyalty points value extracted from the reward_progress JSON.
